  <div class="ws-head">
    <div>
      <h1>Effective Context Trace</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">Trace 3 of 3. One file per sheet, chosen unalike (one well-instrumented, one neglected); seven fixed rows.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-12-effective-context-trace</b><br>
      Pack Z &middot; fill order 5 &middot; diagnostic<br>
      format <b>A3 landscape</b><br>
      audience <b>practitioner</b>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-source">
    Source: <b>ch12 &mdash; The Instrumented Codebase</b> &middot; <i>How Primitives Compose</i> &middot;
    <code>handbook/ch12-the-instrumented-codebase.qmd</code> L385-414 &middot;
    <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch12-the-instrumented-codebase.html#sec-codebase-composition">#sec-codebase-composition</a>
    &middot; needs <b>WS-02</b> first.
  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    For this file, walk the cascade and list every primitive that loads. Mark any layer that is empty (a gap) and any two layers that disagree (a design error).
    Fill column 3 by looking, not from memory. Columns 10 and 11 stay open: hand findings forward, do not close them here.
  </div>
